note: AI infrastructure spending (capex) and forward-committed revenue (backlog / RPO / contracted) for the hyperscalers and neoclouds in the graph. Every figure carries the earnings source it came from. Backlog definitions differ by company — RPO, revenue backlog, contracted lease revenue, purchase commitments — so compare with care.

tiles.label: Big-4 hyperscaler capex, annual pace
tiles.detail: All four now on a calendar-2026 basis: Amazon plan ~$220B (raised on MEMORY costs) + Alphabet guide $195-205B (mid) + Microsoft expectation ~$175B (lease-adjusted) + Meta guide $130-145B (mid). Q2 2026 alone was ~$166B combined.
tiles.source: Meta / Microsoft / Amazon / Alphabet Q2 FY2026

tiles.label: Top-5 hyperscaler capex (NVIDIA view)
tiles.detail: NVIDIA's supplier-side estimate: cloud industry backlog now >$2T; hyperscale revenue to NVIDIA $49B in Q2 FY2027 (+13% QoQ) with growth re-accelerating in Q4 as Vera Rubin supply grows. AWS alone adds 2M GPUs + Vera CPUs through Q2 FY2029.

tiles.label: Microsoft commercial RPO
tiles.detail: ALL sequential growth from non-frontier customers; 2.3-yr avg duration, ~30% converts within 12 months (+37% YoY); Azure +43%, first year above $100B

tiles.label: Oracle RPO
tiles.detail: 12% recognized within 12 months, 34% in months 13-36 — both accelerating; OCI +93%

tiles.label: CoreWeave revenue backlog
tiles.detail: +50% QoQ; 36% converts within 24 months; 10 customers committed >= $1B each

capex_bars.title: Annual capex
capex_bars.note: Annual view — the basis varies by company (fiscal-year actuals, calendar-year guides, trailing twelve months) and each bar states its own. Latest-quarter figures remain in the tables below.

bars.name: Amazon (AWS)
bars.detail: RAISED from ~$200B — 'the higher cost of MEMORY pushing this number up'; TTM actual $173.0B (+$66.1B YoY, 'primarily AI'), Q2 cash capex $53.1B; even at $220B 'still not enough capacity to meet all the demand' in 2026 or 2027

bars.name: Google
bars.detail: Guide RAISED from $180-190B on 'an acceleration in the delivery of capacity'; Q2 alone $44.9B (H1 $80.6B), FCF -$5.9B in Q2; 2027 to increase significantly

bars.name: Microsoft
bars.detail: Calendar-2026 capex expectation ~$175B — investment plans unchanged, restated as DC useful life extends 15->25 yrs and future DC leases shift finance->operating; FY2026 (ended Jun) actual $115.9B (+80%); FQ1 capex >$50B; FY27 capex grows; ~2/3 of spend = short-lived CPUs/GPUs

bars.name: Meta
bars.detail: Guidance NARROWED from $125-145B (bottom end raised); includes finance-lease principal; Q2 alone $31.1B

bars.name: Oracle
bars.detail: Net cash capex; FY2027 guided to ~$70B EXCLUDING $20-25B of customer prepayments

bars.name: Nebius
bars.detail: Q2 capex ~$5.7B; contracted power target RAISED to 5 GW by end-2026; >1 GW of new capacity per year from 2027; connected power 800MW-1GW in 2026

backlog_bars.note: Definitions differ: RPO (Microsoft, Oracle), revenue backlog (CoreWeave), contracted base-term lease revenue (Applied Digital), customer revenue commitments (AWS Trainium, Nebius-Meta, IREN-NVIDIA). Hover a bar for the definition.

bars.name: Oracle

bars.name: Google

bars.name: AWS Trainium
bars.detail: Total Trainium revenue commitments incl. multi-gigawatt training from Anthropic and OpenAI

bars.name: CoreWeave
bars.detail: 36% converts within 24 months, 75% within 4 years; ~5-yr weighted contract length

bars.name: Applied Digital

bars.name: Nebius

rows.name: Amazon
rows.capex_year: 2026 plan RAISED to ~$220B (from ~$200B, on MEMORY costs); TTM actual $173.0B
rows.backlog: AWS backlog $496B (+triple-digit YoY); >$225B Trainium commitments; 2027 capacity largely RESERVED, 'quite a bit' for 2028
rows.signal: AWS +36.7% to $42.2B — 5th straight acceleration, +$4.6B QoQ (80% > biggest ever); AI + chips each >$25B run rate (triple-digit); 'very possibly a TRILLION-dollar business in time'; Trainium sales OUTSIDE the cloud 'a real chance'

rows.name: Microsoft
rows.capex_year: CY2026 expectation ~$175B (lease-adjusted; DC life 15->25yr); FY2026 actual $115.9B (+80%); FQ1 >$50B; FY27 grows
rows.backlog: Commercial RPO $678B (+84%; +25% EX-OpenAI, all seq growth non-frontier; 2.3-yr duration)
rows.signal: Azure +43% past $100B (FQ1 guide ~+45% cc, H1 accelerating; demand > supply, efficiency gains 'quickly monetized'); 31 DCs added in qtr (88 in FY), +1 GW, capacity 2x in 2 yrs; among FIRST to deploy AMD Helios + NVIDIA Vera Rubin racks; Maia 200 +30% perf/$; $3.2B Anthropic-stake gain

rows.name: Meta
rows.capex_year: FY2026 guide NARROWED to $130-145B; NO 2027 outlook — 'maximizing 2026-27 capacity', 2028+ kept flexible (land/power laid, server decisions deferred)
rows.backlog: +$107B contractual commitments added in Q1; NEW: BlackRock JV for a 1 GW El Paso TX data center (Meta Compute)
rows.signal: Revenue $60.8B (+28%); DEMAND-CONSTRAINED incl. core; 'getting a lot of OFFERS FOR COMPUTE at a significant premium' — may sell compute directly (intelligence margin preferred); >1 GW own MTIA (with Broadcom) + AMD + NVIDIA

rows.name: Google (Alphabet)
rows.capex_year: FY2026 guide RAISED to $195-205B (from $180-190B); 2027 up significantly
rows.backlog: Cloud backlog $514B (+>$50B QoQ; >50% converts within 24 months)
rows.signal: Google Cloud +82% to $24.8B, op margin 35.6% (op income 3x); TPU SYSTEM SALES revenue recognition began — first customer-DC deliveries in Q2, vast majority of revenue lands 2027

rows.name: Oracle
rows.capex_year: FY2027 ~$70B net cash capex, EXCLUDING $20-25B customer prepayments
rows.signal: OCI +93%; $67B of AI-infra contracts signed in Q4 alone (majority BYOH/prepaid, $75B total); GPU utilization 97.5%

rows.name: Tencent
rows.capex_q: Q2 2026 capex RMB52,784 million (Q1 2026 RMB31,936 million; Q2 2025 RMB19,107 million); H1 2026 RMB84,720 million
rows.source: Tencent press release: Announcement of the Results for the Three and Six Months (08-12-2026)

rows.name: CoreWeave
rows.capex_year: >$20B capital raised YTD; FY2026 revenue guide $12-13B
rows.signal: Revenue $2.08B (+112%); >1 GW active / >3.5 GW contracted (>8 GW by 2030); 10 customers >= $1B incl. Meta ($21B) and Anthropic

rows.name: Applied Digital
rows.capex_year: $2.15B + $1.59B senior secured notes, $550M revolver fund the build-out
rows.backlog: ~$36B contracted lease revenue, 1.4 GW (~$86B with renewals); ~$20B from ONE hyperscaler
rows.signal: Q4 revenue $258.7M (+407%); Polaris Forge 1 at 175 MW live; five campuses for two hyperscalers + CoreWeave

rows.name: Nebius
rows.capex_year: 2026 capex $20-25B (reaffirmed); >$9B of customer PREPAYMENTS fund it (~70% of Q2 deals prepaid)
rows.signal: Revenue $582M (+454%); group adj EBITDA 41% / Nebius AI 50%; contracted power target RAISED to 5 GW; four >$1B deals (Reflection, Cohere +2) at $20-25M/MW; first auction cleared 15% above best-ever price

rows.name: IREN
rows.capex_year: 95% of GPU capex prepaid or financed at ~3%
rows.backlog: $3.54B 5-yr NVIDIA contract + $2.1B NVIDIA investment (5 GW DSX / 600k GPUs); ARR $3.1B -> $3.7B target
rows.signal: Revenue $144.8M (AI cloud $33.6M); 5 GW secured power; Microsoft Horizon 1-4 (300 MW liquid-cooled); Sweetwater designed for NVIDIA Rubin

rows.capex_year: ~$2B capex in 2026, pre-seeding ~1 GW of new billable capacity

rows.signal: >$350M annualized colocation revenue; 3 hyperscalers engaged on Pecos/Muskogee (1.5 GW each) post-exclusivity
